description: Guided yoga pose timer with sun salutation sequences, per-pose countdowns, and next-pose preview.

faqs.a: Sun Salutation A links 12 poses in a flowing sequence, traditionally repeated for several rounds to warm up the body.
The timer counts down each pose automatically, announces the next pose, and moves on — just follow along.
faqs.q: How does the guided timer work?

faqs.a: Move at your own pace, skip any pose that hurts, and use props or bent knees whenever you need them.
faqs.q: What if a pose is too hard?

howto: Pick a sequence: Sun Salutation A or Moon Salutation.
Hold each pose until the countdown ends.
Follow the next-pose preview to flow smoothly.
title: Yoga Pose Timer
